title: Pilot the new way of working with one or two teams
summary: Try the change with one or two willing teams first. Learn what works, fix what doesn't and build proof before scaling.

beginner: Choose one or two teams that want to try the change.
Agree what they will try and for how long.
Support them closely during the pilot.
intermediate: Set clear measures of success before the pilot starts.
Remove blockers for the pilot teams quickly.
Adjust the approach based on what you learn.
experienced: Choose pilots that will convince sceptical leaders.
Use early wins to build support for scaling.
Plan the move from pilot to wider rollout.

canDelegateTo.task: Support the pilot teams day to day

toolExamples.confluence: Keep a pilot log of what was tried and learned.
toolExamples.miro: Run pilot retrospectives on a shared board.
